The '''LEC 2021 Spring''' was the first split of the 2021 season, organized by Riot Games and held from January 22 to April 11, 2021. Ten franchised teams competed in an online/offline hybrid season broadcast from Berlin, Germany, featuring a Double Round Robin Best-of-One Group Stage followed by a Double Elimination Best-of-Five Playoff. The split champion qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2021|2021 Mid-Season Invitational]] as Europe’s representative.

During the off-season, [[Astralis]] announced their plans to retire the [[Origen]] brand, retiring it after competing in ''League of Legends'' for a total of 6 years <ref name="astralis rebrand 2020">{{cite web|url=https://www.astralis.gg/post/league-of-legends-the-astralis-way|title=League of Legends - The Astralis Way|publisher=[[Astralis]]|date=2020-09-15|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>. On the 18th of November, {{player|Rekkles|flag=se}} left [[Fnatic]] after playing for them for 6 years <ref name="rekkles leaves 3rd">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/FNATIC/status/1329157029462757378|title=After an incredible career in the black and orange, Martin "Rekkles" Larsson has decided to move on from Fnatic.|date=2020-11-18|publisher=[[Fnatic]]|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>. He joined [[G2 Esports]] to team up with former [[Fnatic]] teammate {{player|Caps|flag=dk}} <ref name="Rekkles joins">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/G2esports/status/1329816841733214213|title=A dream come true|author=[[G2 Esports]] |publisher=Twitter|date=2020-11-20}}</ref>. On the 20th of November, {{player|Perkz|flag=hr}} officially parted ways with [[G2 Esports]], joining North American team [[Cloud9]] <ref name="Perkz joins">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/Cloud9/status/1329847234209345536|title=We are bringing the most accomplished and most impactful Western player in the history of League of Legends to #C9LoL.|date=2020-11-20|author=[[Cloud9]]|publisher=Twitter|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>.

Former [[Excel Esports]] jungler {{player|Caedrel|flag=uk}} announced his retirement on the 3rd of November, joining the ''LEC'' analyst desk for the 2021 spring season <ref name="Caedrel leaves">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/Caedrel/status/1323624029085933570 |title=Announcement |date=2020-11-03|publisher=Twitter |author=[[Caedrel]] |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>. Retiring on the 6th of January was [[SK Gaming]] jungler {{player|Trick|flag=kr}} <ref name="Trick retires">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/Tricklol12/status/1346809395347222534 |title=Bye progamer life maybe esports life was really fun and i had good experience |date=2021-01-06 |author=[[Trick]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|uk}} English}}</ref>.

===Playoffs===
{{#lst:LEC/2021/Spring/Playoffs|Playoffs}}

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''January 22nd - March 14th, 2021''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 6th place will play the Playoffs
***1st to 4th place are seeded into Semifinals
***5th and 6th place are seeded into Losers' Round 1

* '''Playoffs''' - ''March 26th - April 11th, 2021''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2021|Mid-Season Invitational 2021]]
